scope: One debug-only native landscape writing page; no production or storage changes.
prior_multi_mode_proposal: Rejected overall by user; retained for comparison.

reference.implementation_method: Original Compose composition from parent-verified written design specification

capture.method: Android UiAutomation.takeScreenshot; original PNG, no cropping or retouching
capture.content: Synthetic study notes using existing bundled WenKai font and native Canvas vectors

build.dependencies: Existing external verification init script substitutes a complete source-built MuPDF fitz 1.28.5 AAR; production dependency declarations unchanged

checks: paper occupies at least 95% of available width
color and stroke width selection, native pointer stroke
undo, redo and return to clean fixture
native confirmation of any first-run immersive tutorial; assert tutorial absent before capture

limits: Not UX approval or production integration.
Only landscape at font scale 1.0; other modes and viewports not expanded.
Temporary in-memory ink; lasso only shows selection and eraser removes the latest temporary stroke.
Navigation, search, panels and more entries remain disabled placeholders.
This debug Activity hides the Android navigation bar; edge swipe temporarily reveals it.
Software emulator API 36; no handwriting latency or PDF renderer claim.

followup.user_feedback: 这次改动比原来好了很多
